from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Initialize Scene Layout
        title_text = "Prerequisites: Energy and Momentum"
        lecture_lines = [
            "Momentum and kinetic energy are conserved in every collision.",
            "We can plot velocities v and V as a point.",
            "Energy conservation defines a state-space trajectory.",
            "This path forms a squashed ellipse on the graph.",
            "Every collision shifts our position along this curve."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)

        # Defining Colors as per Storyboard/Requirements
        MOMENTUM_COLOR = "#00FF00"
        ENERGY_COLOR = "#FFFF00"
        AXES_COLOR = "#FFFFFF"
        POINT_COLOR = "#FFFFFF"

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Momentum and kinetic energy are conserved in every collision.
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(MOMENTUM_COLOR))
        
        momentum_formula = MathTex("mv + MV = p", color=MOMENTUM_COLOR)
        energy_formula = MathTex(r"\frac{1}{2}mv^2 + \frac{1}{2}MV^2 = E", color=ENERGY_COLOR)
        
        self.place_at_grid(momentum_formula, "A4", scale_factor=0.8)
        self.place_at_grid(energy_formula, "B4", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(Write(momentum_formula), run_time=1)
        self.play(Write(energy_formula), run_time=1)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # We can plot velocities v and V as a point.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(AXES_COLOR)
        )
        
        # Grid Coordinates for coordinate plane
        origin_pos = self.grid["E3"]
        v_axis_end = self.grid["E6"]
        V_axis_end = self.grid["B3"]
        
        # Build Axes
        axes_v = Line(origin_pos, v_axis_end, color=AXES_COLOR).add_tip()
        axes_V = Line(origin_pos, V_axis_end, color=AXES_COLOR).add_tip()
        label_v = MathTex("v", color=AXES_COLOR).scale(0.8).next_to(v_axis_end, RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        label_V = MathTex("V", color=AXES_COLOR).scale(0.8).next_to(V_axis_end, UP, buff=0.1)
        
        # Define a point on the grid (velocities)
        a_param = 1.8  # Semi-major axis for v
        b_param = 0.9  # Semi-minor axis for V (squashed)
        
        point_mobject = Dot(color=POINT_COLOR)
        initial_theta = PI/4
        initial_pos = origin_pos + np.array([a_param * np.cos(initial_theta), b_param * np.sin(initial_theta), 0])
        point_mobject.move_to(initial_pos)
        
        self.play(Create(axes_v), Create(axes_V), Write(label_v), Write(label_V))
        self.play(FadeIn(point_mobject))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Energy conservation defines a state-space trajectory.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(ENERGY_COLOR)
        )
        # Visual link: highlight energy formula as the constraint source
        self.play(Indicate(energy_formula, color=ENERGY_COLOR))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # This path forms a squashed ellipse on the graph.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(ENERGY_COLOR)
        )
        
        # Draw the ellipse representing the conservation of energy
        ellipse = Ellipse(width=2*a_param, height=2*b_param, color=ENERGY_COLOR, stroke_width=3)
        ellipse.move_to(origin_pos)
        
        self.play(Create(ellipse))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Every collision shifts our position along this curve.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[4].animate.set_color(POINT_COLOR)
        )
        
        # Move point along the ellipse to represent a change in velocity state
        def move_on_ellipse(t):
            # Move from PI/4 to 3*PI/4 along the elliptical path
            theta = PI/4 + t * (PI/2)
            return origin_pos + np.array([a_param * np.cos(theta), b_param * np.sin(theta), 0])

        self.play(
            UpdateFromAlphaFunc(point_mobject, lambda m, p: m.move_to(move_on_ellipse(p))),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        self.wait(2)
